# IPRwise: Universal AI & MCP Plugin

![IPRwise](assets/iprwise-512.png)

This repository connects AI coding tools, IDEs, and desktop agents to **[IPRwise](https://www.iprwise.com)** ([iprwise.com/ai](https://www.iprwise.com/ai)), the global network of trademark and patent attorneys, via the hosted remote MCP server at `https://www.iprwise.com/mcp` (**25 read-only tools**, **5 skills**, and always-on citation guardrails).

Multiple plugin manifests live side by side in this single repository so each client reads its native format automatically. For Claude's dedicated plugin marketplace format, see [asimokat/iprwise-claude-eklenti](https://github.com/asimokat/iprwise-claude-eklenti).

**Türkçe:** [kurulum ve özet aşağıda](#türkçe)

## What is inside

| File / Folder | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `.antigravity-plugin/plugin.json`, `mcp_config.json`, `assets/antigravity-logo.png` | Native Google Antigravity plugin manifest, remote MCP config, and padded 128×128 icon. |
| `gemini-extension.json` | Native extension manifest for Gemini CLI and Qwen Code. |
| `plugin.json`, `mcp.json` | Agent Plugins manifest and Streamable HTTP MCP config for OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and Kiro Powers. |
| `rules/AGENTS.md` | Always-on verification rules (never invent deadlines, official fees, POA rules, treaty dates, or attorney contact details; cite official sources). |
| `skills/filing-strategy` | Multi-country trademark, patent, and design filing plan (treaties, `ip_deadline`, `official_fees`, `nice_2027_check`). |
| `skills/foreign-associate` | Selecting and instructing local IP counsel (`country_ip_facts`, `find_attorneys`, `attorney_profile`, instruction letter). |
| `skills/refusal-triage` | Triaging WIPO Madrid provisional refusals and national office actions (`madrid_mark`, `madrid_refusals`, `ip_deadline`, `goods_services_terms`). |
| `skills/ip-watch-and-leads` | Competitor Madrid/PCT portfolio audits (`competitor_filings`, `pct_applicant_tracker`, `non_use_candidates`) and jurisdiction practice digests (`open_tasks`, `domain_gaps`, `madrid_renewals`, `madrid_office_leads`, `mark_watch_matches`). |
| `skills/get-started` | Onboarding guide and starter prompts. |
| `deepseek-harness/` | DeepSeek Harness (`~/.dsh`) patch fragment, verification rules, and Windows/macOS/Linux installer scripts (`kur.ps1`, `kur.sh`). |
| `llms-install.md`, `assets/logo-400.png` | 1-prompt automated setup instructions and 400×400 icon for Cline. |

## Setup across AI clients

| Client | How to install & connect |
|---|---|
| **Claude** (`claude.ai`, Desktop, Claude Code) | Dedicated Claude repo: **Customize → Plugins → Add marketplace → `asimokat/iprwise-claude-eklenti`**, or in Claude Code: `claude plugin marketplace add asimokat/iprwise-claude-eklenti && claude plugin install iprwise@iprwise` (connector only: `claude mcp add --transport http --scope user iprwise https://www.iprwise.com/mcp`). |
| **ChatGPT** | Install [IPRwise on ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6add4fdcfe108191b262e938b47ad7a1) and sign in with your IPRwise account. |
| **Google Antigravity** | Run `agy plugin install https://github.com/asimokat/iprwise-eklenti` (or clone into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/iprwise` and restart Antigravity). Remove any duplicate manual `iprwise` entry from user `mcp_config.json`. |
| **Cursor** | In `.cursor/mcp.json` or **Cursor Settings → MCP → Add new global MCP server**, add `{"mcpServers": {"iprwise": {"url": "https://www.iprwise.com/mcp"}}}` and complete browser sign-in. |
| **VS Code / GitHub Copilot** | Copilot CLI: `copilot plugin install asimokat/iprwise-eklenti`. In VS Code `.vscode/mcp.json`: `{"servers": {"iprwise": {"type": "http", "url": "https://www.iprwise.com/mcp"}}}`. |
| **Gemini CLI** | `gemini extensions install https://github.com/asimokat/iprwise-eklenti` |
| **Qwen Code** | `qwen extensions install asimokat/iprwise-eklenti` |
| **Codex CLI** | `codex plugin marketplace add asimokat/iprwise-eklenti` |
| **Windsurf** | In `~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json`, add `{"mcpServers": {"iprwise": {"serverUrl": "https://www.iprwise.com/mcp"}}}` (or use the `npx -y mcp-remote https://www.iprwise.com/mcp` bridge). |
| **Cline** | Tell Cline: *"Install the IPRwise MCP server following `llms-install.md` in `https://github.com/asimokat/iprwise-eklenti`"*, then click **Authenticate** in Cline's MCP Servers panel. |
| **Kiro** | Open **Powers → Add Custom Power** and enter `https://github.com/asimokat/iprwise-eklenti`. |
| **Zed** | Add `iprwise` under `context_servers` in Zed `settings.json` using `"command": {"path": "npx", "args": ["-y", "mcp-remote", "https://www.iprwise.com/mcp"]}`. |
| **Goose** | Run `goose configure` → **Add Extension** → **Remote Extension (Streamable HTTP)** → URL `https://www.iprwise.com/mcp`, or add to `~/.config/goose/config.yaml`. |
| **DeepSeek Harness** | Generate a Personal MCP API Key (`iprw_key_...`) at [iprwise.com/ai](https://www.iprwise.com/ai), then run `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File deepseek-harness\kur.ps1` (Windows) or `bash deepseek-harness/kur.sh` (macOS/Linux) and fully restart DeepSeek Harness. |
| **xAI Grok API, Groq API, Mistral, Perplexity, LibreChat, Open WebUI** | Connect `https://www.iprwise.com/mcp` via OAuth (Mistral Le Chat, Perplexity) or pass `Authorization: Bearer iprw_key_...` (generated at [iprwise.com/ai](https://www.iprwise.com/ai)). |
| **Poe, Coze, Dify, n8n, Make, Custom GPT Actions** | Import the OpenAPI 3.1 schema `https://www.iprwise.com/openapi.json` (6 zero-auth endpoints + 25-tool `/api/mcp/tools/{toolName}` REST bridge). |

### Tools (25 read-only tools)

The server exposes 25 tools at `https://www.iprwise.com/mcp`. Every tool is strictly read-only (`readOnlyHint: true`, `destructiveHint: false`); none modifies user profiles, watch lists, directory entries, or tasks.

**Reference, directory and marketplace (7)**

| Tool | What it returns | Read-only |
|---|---|---|
| `country_ip_facts` | Key IP facts for 191 jurisdictions: IP office, main statute, trademark/patent/utility model/design protection terms, opposition and non-use cancellation periods, local agent rule, POA formalities, and filing language — each with the official source URL and a verbatim quote. | yes |
| `filing_routes` | Up to 25 jurisdictions in one call: Paris Convention, PCT, Madrid Protocol, and Hague Agreement effective dates, plus EUIPO, Benelux, EPO (member, extension, validation), EAPO, OAPI, and ARIPO (Harare, Banjul), flagging accessions not yet in force. | yes |
| `find_attorneys` | 25,000+ IP attorneys and firms: KYC-verified IPRwise members first, followed by public-source records (such as the EPO professional representatives list, EAPO, and public business listings), filterable by country, practice, and city, with iprwise.com profile links. | yes |
| `attorney_profile` | Single public IPRwise directory profile by slug (from `find_attorneys`), including verification status and profile link. Removed profiles are never returned. | yes |
| `open_tasks` | Open cross-border IP work requests posted on IPRwise: NDA-safe public summary and direct link to `https://www.iprwise.com/tasks/<id>`. | yes |
| `ip_news` | IPRwise IP Radar: official IP office announcements (fee changes, new laws, treaty accessions, e-filing updates, practice notices) with effective dates and source links; summaries in nine languages. | yes |
| `nice_2027_check` | Checks goods and services terms against the 2027 edition of the Nice Classification (NCL 13-2027): added, deleted, reworded, or moved terms with new wording. | yes |

**Deterministic calculators (2)**

| Tool | What it returns | Read-only |
|---|---|---|
| `ip_deadline` | Statutory deadlines at 12 offices (`USPTO`, `EPO`, `EUIPO`, `TR` / TÜRKPATENT, `WIPO`, `UKIPO`, `DPMA`, `JPO`, `CNIPA`, `KIPO`, `CIPO`, `IPAU`): applies end-of-month rule, skips weekends and official closure days, and cites the legal rule and calendar source. | yes |
| `official_fees` | Official trademark filing fees of 13 offices (`US`, `EM`, `GB`, `TR`, `DE`, `JP`, `CN`, `KR`, `CA`, `AU`, `BR`, `CH`, `IN`) and WIPO Madrid total in CHF (basic fee, individual/complementary fees including Art. 9sexies, supplementary class fees), with source links and tariff dates. | yes |

**WIPO Madrid, Hague and PCT data (11)**

| Tool | What it returns | Read-only |
|---|---|---|
| `madrid_mark` | Looks up a single WIPO Madrid registration by IRN with its refusal history, or searches Madrid registrations by mark name. | yes |
| `madrid_refusals` | Open provisional refusals on Madrid registrations with response deadlines, filterable by refusing office, Nice class, office of origin, and total/partial type. | yes |
| `madrid_office_scorecard` | Office-level Madrid statistics: refusal counts, outcomes, median days to first decision and closure, and refusal rates by Nice class. | yes |
| `madrid_top_representatives` | Most active Madrid representatives (new international applications and subsequent designations) over the last 30 days, with main clients. | yes |
| `goods_services_terms` | Goods and services terms cut, objected to, or restricted by offices in Madrid designations, by Nice class. | yes |
| `competitor_filings` | Recent Madrid filings (last 60 days) and international Madrid portfolio of a company or brand, with designated countries. | yes |
| `brand_expansions` | Brands designating new countries via new Madrid registrations or subsequent designations. | yes |
| `non_use_candidates` | Madrid registrations old enough for non-use cancellation across 17 jurisdictions, ranked, citing the statute. | yes |
| `hague_designs` | Hague international designs designating an office: `recent`, `expiring` (within 90 days), `unrepresented`, or `refused`. | yes |
| `pct_national_phase_leads` | PCT applications nearing 30/31-month national phase entry at a target office, from WIPO PATENTSCOPE weekly gazettes. | yes |
| `pct_applicant_tracker` | PCT patent portfolio, Madrid marks, top inventors/IPC/Nice classes, and open refusals of an applicant or inventor. | yes |

**Member office and watch tools (5)** *(same visibility rules as iprwise.com: scoped to the signed-in member's profile office; first 10 rows + total for unverified members, full list for verified members)*

| Tool | What it returns | Read-only |
|---|---|---|
| `domain_gaps` | Brands newly designated to the member's country via Madrid whose corresponding local country-code domain appears unregistered/open. | yes |
| `madrid_renewals` | International registrations in the member's office nearing 10-year renewal (next 6 or 12 months) or in the 6-month renewal grace period. | yes |
| `madrid_office_leads` | Six daily lists for the member's office: `lapsed` marks, `transformation` leads, open Paris `priority` window, US/PH use `declarations` due, `ownership_changes`, and foreign `inbound_firms`. | yes |
| `madrid_portfolio` | Madrid portfolio and open provisional refusals (nearest deadline first), renewals, and use declarations of a representative firm. | yes |
| `mark_watch_matches` | New Madrid matches against the member's saved similar-mark watch list on iprwise.com, with opposition deadlines. | yes |

### Connecting and signing in (OAuth 2.1)

- **Endpoint:** `https://www.iprwise.com/mcp` (use `www.` exactly as written)
- **Transport:** Streamable HTTP (stateless JSON responses)
- **Official MCP Registry name:** `com.iprwise/mcp`
- **Authorization:** OAuth 2.1 Authorization Code + PKCE (`S256`), public clients (`token_endpoint_auth_method: none`), scopes `iprwise` and `offline_access`
- **Client discovery:** Both Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD) and Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591) at `https://www.iprwise.com/api/oauth/register`
- **Metadata endpoints:** `https://www.iprwise.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp` and `https://www.iprwise.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`

On first use, your MCP client opens an `iprwise.com` consent page in the browser. Sign in with your IPRwise account (Google, LinkedIn, Microsoft, or e-mail — a free IPRwise account is enough) and click **Allow**.

For clients that only support local `stdio` servers, bridge to the remote endpoint with `mcp-remote`, which opens the same browser OAuth flow:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "iprwise": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "mcp-remote", "https://www.iprwise.com/mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

### Check the connection

Ask your assistant: `"Is Türkiye a member of the Madrid Protocol, and since when?"` It should call `filing_routes` and report: member since **1 January 1999**.

## Privacy, limits and security

- **Remote MCP only:** This plugin connects solely to `https://www.iprwise.com/mcp` over HTTPS. It bundles no local servers, binaries, or lifecycle hooks.
- **No query-text logging:** Question text and tool arguments are not stored. Server logs record only tool name, duration, response size, error flag, client name, and a shortened account ID.
- **Read-only scope:** All 25 tools have `readOnlyHint: true`. The connector cannot edit your profile or watch list and cannot access private messages, private task attachments, or payment details.
- **Retention & rate limits:** Daily call counters (300 calls/day per account, up to 60/day per live search tool, resetting at 00:00 UTC) expire after 12 months; OAuth codes/tokens are stored only as SHA-256 hashes and purged within 30 days of expiry.
- **Policies & support:** [AI Overview](https://www.iprwise.com/ai) · [FAQ & Support](https://www.iprwise.com/legal?doc=faq) (`info@iprwise.com`) · [Privacy Policy (Section 4)](https://www.iprwise.com/privacy) · [Terms of Service](https://www.iprwise.com/terms)

## Türkçe

Bu depo, [IPRwise](https://www.iprwise.com) ([iprwise.com/ai](https://www.iprwise.com/ai)) küresel fikri mülkiyet vekilleri ağını ve WIPO veri araçlarını tüm modern yapay zekâ istemcilerine bağlayan çok biçimli eklentidir (`https://www.iprwise.com/mcp` üzerinde **25 salt okunur alet**, **5 skill** ve her zaman açık doğrulama kuralları). Claude'un kendi eklenti pazarı biçimi için: [asimokat/iprwise-claude-eklenti](https://github.com/asimokat/iprwise-claude-eklenti).

### Hızlı Kurulum (Türkçe)

| Araç | Kurulum |
|---|---|
| **Claude** (`claude.ai`, Masaüstü, Claude Code) | `asimokat/iprwise-claude-eklenti` pazarını ekleyin veya `claude mcp add --transport http --scope user iprwise https://www.iprwise.com/mcp` çalıştırın. |
| **ChatGPT** | [ChatGPT'de IPRwise](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6add4fdcfe108191b262e938b47ad7a1) sayfasından kurup IPRwise hesabınızla giriş yapın. |
| **Google Antigravity** | `agy plugin install https://github.com/asimokat/iprwise-eklenti` |
| **Gemini CLI / Qwen Code** | `gemini extensions install https://github.com/asimokat/iprwise-eklenti` · `qwen extensions install asimokat/iprwise-eklenti` |
| **Codex CLI / Copilot CLI** | `codex plugin marketplace add asimokat/iprwise-eklenti` · `copilot plugin install asimokat/iprwise-eklenti` |
| **Kiro** | Powers → Add Custom Power → `https://github.com/asimokat/iprwise-eklenti` |
| **Cline** | Cline'a `https://github.com/asimokat/iprwise-eklenti` deposundaki `llms-install.md` dosyasına göre kurmasını söyleyin ve **Authenticate** düğmesine basın. |
| **Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Zed, Goose** | Streamable HTTP MCP sunucusu olarak `https://www.iprwise.com/mcp` adresini ekleyin (yalnız stdio destekleyenlerde `npx -y mcp-remote https://www.iprwise.com/mcp`). |
| **DeepSeek Harness (`~/.dsh`)** | [iprwise.com/ai](https://www.iprwise.com/ai) sayfasından kişisel anahtarınızı (`iprw_key_...`) üretip `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File deepseek-harness\kur.ps1` (veya `bash deepseek-harness/kur.sh`) çalıştırın; ardından DeepSeek Harness'ı sistem tepsisinden tamamen kapatıp yeniden açın (`mcp__iprwise__*` aletleri görünür). |
| **xAI Grok API, Groq API, Mistral, Perplexity, LibreChat, Open WebUI** | `https://www.iprwise.com/mcp` adresine OAuth (Mistral, Perplexity) veya `Authorization: Bearer iprw_key_...` başlığıyla bağlanın. |
| **Poe, Coze, Dify, n8n, Make, Custom GPT Actions** | OpenAPI 3.1 şemasını içe aktarın: `https://www.iprwise.com/openapi.json` |

İlk kullanımda tarayıcıda `iprwise.com` onay sayfası açılır; ücretsiz bir IPRwise hesabıyla (Google, LinkedIn, Microsoft veya e-posta) giriş yapıp **İzin ver** (`Allow`) demeniz yeterlidir. 25 aletin tamamı salt okunurdur; soru metinleri ve alet parametreleri kaydedilmez ([KVKK ve Gizlilik, Bölüm 4](https://www.iprwise.com/kvkk)).

### Connecting and signing in (OAuth 2.1)

- **Endpoint:** `https://www.iprwise.com/mcp` (use `www.` exactly as written)
- **Transport:** Streamable HTTP (stateless JSON responses)
- **Official MCP Registry name:** `com.iprwise/mcp`
- **Authorization:** OAuth 2.1 Authorization Code + PKCE (`S256`), public clients (`token_endpoint_auth_method: none`), scopes `iprwise` and `offline_access`
- **Client discovery:** Both Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD) and Dynamic Client Registration (RFC 7591) at `https://www.iprwise.com/api/oauth/register`
- **Metadata endpoints:** `https://www.iprwise.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp` and `https://www.iprwise.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`

On first use, your MCP client opens an `iprwise.com` consent page in the browser. Sign in with your IPRwise account (Google, LinkedIn, Microsoft, or e-mail — a free IPRwise account is enough) and click **Allow**.

For clients that only support local `stdio` servers, bridge to the remote endpoint with `mcp-remote`, which opens the same browser OAuth flow:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "iprwise": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "mcp-remote", "https://www.iprwise.com/mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

### Check the connection

Ask your assistant: `"Is Türkiye a member of the Madrid Protocol, and since when?"` It should call `filing_routes` and report: member since **1 January 1999**.

## Privacy, limits and security

- **Remote MCP only:** This plugin connects solely to `https://www.iprwise.com/mcp` over HTTPS. It bundles no local servers, binaries, or lifecycle hooks.
- **No query-text logging:** Question text and tool arguments are not stored. Server logs record only tool name, duration, response size, error flag, client name, and a shortened account ID.
- **Read-only scope:** All 25 tools have `readOnlyHint: true`. The connector cannot edit your profile or watch list and cannot access private messages, private task attachments, or payment details.
- **Retention & rate limits:** Daily call counters (300 calls/day per account, up to 60/day per live search tool, resetting at 00:00 UTC) expire after 12 months; OAuth codes/tokens are stored only as SHA-256 hashes and purged within 30 days of expiry.
- **Policies & support:** [AI Overview](https://www.iprwise.com/ai) · [FAQ & Support](https://www.iprwise.com/legal?doc=faq) (`info@iprwise.com`) · [Privacy Policy (Section 4)](https://www.iprwise.com/privacy) · [Terms of Service](https://www.iprwise.com/terms)
